verdict.rationale: Cactus is built for on-device inference. The vendor states "no GPU, no server, and no data leaving the device." It documents local install and run (brew install, cactus run) on macOS, Linux and Windows, and community users report it running offline on phones and on a Framework Desktop. missing for 10: no documentation that the automatic cloud routing of hard queries can be disabled or is opt-in, and no independent verification that no data leaves the device.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: No GPU, no server, and no data leaving the device.
macOS and Linux on Arm and x86, Windows on x64 and Arm64, Python 3.9 or newer, no GPU.
Step 1: brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus - Step 2: cactus run
called the fastest offline LLM seen on that phone
